fieldguide.entity.netherman.azazel.descr: A formerly sealed spirit of the sun and hellfire, Azazel has returned to plunge the Nether into even greater peril.
fieldguide.entity.netherman.blacksmith.d: A devoted follower of Azazel. Creates unique armaments for their god.
fieldguide.entity.netherman.doctor.descr: A devoted follower. Heals in the name of Azazel.
fieldguide.entity.netherman.ghastly.desc: A creature that can sniff out Azazel's influence.
fieldguide.entity.netherman.gilded_golem: A block of gold given unholy life. As the power of Azazel imbued it, it began to melt perpetually.
fieldguide.entity.netherman.guardian.des: A devoted follower of Azazel. Protects the city at all costs.
A devoted follower of Azazel. Spreads the word around the Nether.
fieldguide.entity.netherman.piglin_priso: A piglin, taken as prisoner in the name of Azazel.
fieldguide.entity.netherman.trader.descr: A devoted follower of Azazel, willing to part with resources to collect offerings in their name.
fieldguide.entity.netherman.villager_pri: A prisoner, taken in the name of Azazel.
fieldguide.entity.netherman.welcomer.des: A devoted follower of Azazel, guiding you into their majestic city.
